name: PT Distribusi Voucher Nusantara Tbk
summary: PT Distribusi Voucher Nusantara Tbk provides digital products, payment solution services, and online-to-offline (O2O) platforms in Indonesia. The company offers smart EDC/unified payment system; self-service vending machines; LockerIn that assists visitors who want to leave items and retrieve items with a self-made pin or QR receipt; Dolan, an online-onsite ticketing and point of sales system to maximize tourism business management; Parkour, an integrated parking ecosystem solution with cashless payment; point of sales (POS); and Diva intelligent instant messaging platform.
